promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.description: Manage catalog-wide, category, and product discounts.
promotions.readOnly: You can view promotions but cannot change them.
promotions.noSelectionDescription: Choose a promotion from the list or create a new one.

publicLabel.label: Public label
publicLabel.help: Optional label shown to visitors in this language.

discountType.label: Discount type
discountType.help: Choose percentage or a fixed VAT-inclusive EUR amount.

discountValue.label: Discount value
discountValue.help: Use up to two decimal places. A fixed discount at or above a product price is skipped for that product.

categories.label: Categories
categories.help: Selected categories include every descendant category and both primary and additional product assignments.

products.label: Products
products.help: Enquiry products may remain selected but never receive a promotional price.

endsAt.label: Ends at
endsAt.help: Optional, in UTC. The promotion is inactive at this exact time.

results.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to manage promotions.
results.STALE: This promotion changed in another session. Reload the latest version before saving again.

promotions.unsavedChanges: This promotion has unsaved changes. Continue and discard them?
